description: Dependency updates grouped by the families that must move together. Nothing is merged automatically: every pull request is compiled and tested by the build workflow before it is taken.

packageRules.description: AGP 9.3.x+ outruns what the locally installed Android Studio supports — sync fails with unsupported-AGP-version and "could not find compile target" errors. Hold AGP updates until Studio's bundled support catches up.
Gradle 9.7+ doesn't work with the current IntelliJ, so the wrapper is pinned to 9.6.x. Still allows 9.6 patch releases; lift this once IntelliJ supports 9.7.
Compose ships as one family (BOM, androidx.compose.* and org.jetbrains.compose.*): bumping a piece without the rest is what breaks a KMP build.
Kotlin, its Compose compiler plugin and KSP are released together and only work in matching versions.
Room and the SQLite driver it bundles are versioned together.
Ktor client and its engines/converters share a version.
